description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableJsonField class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package, using JUnit and Mockito for testing and verification.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutableJsonField, validating immutability, equality, null handling, key retrieval, error conditions, string representation, and interface compliance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableJsonField instances are immutable and that related fields and classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonField correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullKey
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonField with a null key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating an ImmutableJsonField with a null value throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getKeyNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getKeyName returns the string representation of the JsonKey.

methods.name: twoHashSetsWithSameJsonFieldsAreEqual
methods.description: Tests that sets containing logically equal JsonField objects are considered equal.

methods.name: fieldHasNoDefinitionByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that a new ImmutableJsonField does not have a definition unless specified.

methods.name: getDefinitionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getDefinition returns the correct definition if set.

methods.name: fieldWithoutDefinitionIsNotMarkedAtAll
methods.description: Verifies that an unmarked field returns false for isMarkedAs.

methods.name: fieldWithSchemaVersionMarkerIsMarkedCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures that if a field is marked as a specific schema version, isMarkedAs returns true.

methods.name: toStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toString implementation outputs expected JSON format.

methods.name: createInstanceViaInterfaceReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that a JsonField instance created via interface method has correct key and value.
